upg4:1.1: Those heroes, sat on their thrones, after defeating Māra and his host,
upg4:1.2: those who are bulls of men, drank of the ambrosia of the four truths.
upg4:2.1: Those twenty eight leaders, Buddhas, beginning with Taṇhaṅkara,
upg4:2.2: are all established on the crown of your head, they are lords of sages.
upg4:3.1: The Buddhas are established on your head, and the Dhamma on your eyes,
upg4:3.2: the Saṅgha, the fount of all good qualities is established on your chest,
upg4:4.1: On your heart is Anuruddha, and Sāriputta on your right,
upg4:4.2: Koṇḍañña is on your back, and Moggallāna on your left.
upg4:5.1: On your right ear (are established these two) Ānanda and Rāhula,
upg4:5.2: Kassapa and Mahānāma, these two (are established) on your left ear.
upg4:6.1: At the end of your hair at the back like the sun, the light maker -
upg4:6.2: is seated the glorious Sobhita, who is a bull of a sage.
upg4:7.1: The one named Kumārakassapa, great sage, and beautiful speaker,
upg4:7.2: that fount of good qualities is permanently established on your mouth.
upg4:8.1: Puṇṇa, Aṅgulimāla, Upāli, Nanda, and Sivalī -
upg4:8.2: these five true elders (are established like) auspicious signs on your forehead.
upg4:9.1: The remaining eighty great elders, victors, disciples of the victor,
upg4:9.2: shining with the power of virtue, are established on your limbs.
upg4:10.1: To the front is “The Treasures” on the right “The Friendliness Discourse”,
upg4:10.2: “The Banner” is at the back, and “Aṅgulimāla” is on the left,
upg4:11.1: The “Constituent Groups” and “Peacock” safeguards, and the “Āṭānāṭiya Discourse”,
upg4:11.2: cover the space (around you), the remainder are a fence, so to speak.
upg4:12.1: With the strength of the victor’s order, equipped with the fence of the Dhamma,
upg4:12.2: engaged in the four duties, in the Sambuddhas’ armour forever,
upg4:13.1: may all internal and external adversities that arise, beginning with wind and bile,
upg4:13.2: through the power of (the Buddhas’) endless virtues, come to a complete end.
upg4:14.1: While living on this great earth, standing in the midst of the victors’ armour,
upg4:14.2: may all of those great bulls of men watch over you forever.
upg4:15.1: Thus being continuously well protected, with adversity defeated through the victors’ power,
upg4:15.2: with the crowd of foes destroyed through the Buddhas’ power, live on, guarded by the power of the true Dhamma!
upg4:16.1: Thus being continuously well protected, with adversity defeated through the victors’ power,
upg4:16.2: with the crowd of foes destroyed through the Dhamma’s power, live on, guarded by the power of the true Dhamma!
upg4:17.1: Thus being continuously well protected, with adversity defeated through the victors’ power,
upg4:17.2: with the crowd of foes destroyed through the Saṅgha’s power, live on, guarded by the power of the true Dhamma!
upg4:18.1: You are defended by the fence of the true Dhamma, with the eight noble ones in the eight directions,
upg4:18.2: and in between these (directions) are the eight lords, and above, like a canopy, stand the victors.
upg4:19.1: Breaking Māra’s army, the Teacher who sat under the Bodhi tree now rests on your head.
upg4:19.2: You have Moggallāna dwelling on your left hand side, and Sāriputta on your right.
upg4:19.3: ° The Dhamma dwells in the middle of your chest, the Awakening One who took birth from
upg4:19.4: out of a peahen’s womb has come to your feet, he is brilliant, the world’s sole protector.
upg4:20.1: All inauspicious events, adversities, and bad signs,
upg4:20.2: all calamities, diseases, blame, bad planets, bar none,
upg4:20.3: all obstacles, fears, and unpleasant dreams -
upg4:20.4: may (all of them), through the excellent power of the Buddha, go to destruction!
upg4:21.1: All inauspicious events, adversities, and bad signs,
upg4:21.2: all calamities, diseases, blame, bad planets, bar none,
upg4:21.3: all obstacles, fears, and unpleasant dreams -
upg4:21.4: may (all of them), through the excellent power of the Dhamma, go to destruction!
upg4:22.1: All inauspicious events, adversities, and bad signs,
upg4:22.2: all calamities, diseases, blame, bad planets, bar none,
upg4:22.3: all obstacles, fears, and unpleasant dreams -
upg4:22.4: may (all of them), through the excellent power of the Saṅgha, go to destruction!
